common_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production hand-painted frame-by-frame 2D game animation sprite sheet. Reference image is ONLY the identity/costume/material reference: this exact bareheaded undead soldier, swept brown hair, pale gaunt clouded-eyed face, tattered olive WW2 uniform, red shoulder boards, medals, brown diagonal leather strap and belt pouches, torn trousers, tall black boots. Draw COMPLETE organically painted bodies in every frame, never cutout puppet parts or separate limbs. Anatomical shoulders at sides of upper chest below neck, normal connected short neck, elbows and knees bend correctly. Consistent character proportions, same costume details, consistent light and color, no weapons. Fixed SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT in EVERY cell. Transparent background, NO floor, NO shadows, NO grid lines, NO text, NO numbers, NO effects, no extra props.
MANDATORY LAYOUT: square PNG exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows of sixteen equal cells. EXACTLY ONE complete body in EACH cell, sequential frames left-to-right top-to-bottom. Camera scale identical all sixteen cells. Frame cell coordinates expressed as percentages: foot-ground baseline at y=88%, stationary hip/root x=50%. Standing character height 72% of cell; leave ample padding all sides and don't clip fingers or feet. No character crosses a cell border. This is drawn animation, each cell is a new cohesive painted pose with changing cloth/shoulder/body volumes, not rigid pieces rotated at joints. Same fixed camera, no perspective turn.

idle.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: 16 consecutive frames of a seamless stationary idle breathing loop, slight uneasy forward stoop, naturally hanging loosely bent arms, subtle chest breath and weight shift, feet planted, head firmly connected at collar. All sixteen drawn poses differ subtly, no walking.

patrol.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: 16 consecutive evenly spaced frames of ONE complete seamless slow walking cycle in place facing RIGHT. Alternate heel strike, weight-bearing stance, passing pose, toe-off and bent-knee foot lift. Slight natural arm counter-swing from shoulders, hunched undead gait yet believable human anatomy. Start right heel forward, first and last frames neighbouring poses. Same stationary root in every cell, no travelling across cells.

chase.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: 16 evenly spaced frames of a complete seamless brisk hunched chasing WALK cycle in place. Fixed side profile facing RIGHT, alternate heel strike, passing poses and toe-off; natural small counter-swing arms. Brisk human weight transfer, slightly forward leaning zombie, no sprint, no foot sliding, no rigid puppet look. Stationary hips root. Must be 4 by 4 transparent sprite sheet.

windup.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: 16 consecutive frames of a stationary melee attack ANTICIPATION followed by outward swing. Begin arms loosely in front of hips. Frames 1-10 draw both hands back close to ribs and bend elbows, shoulders behind hands. Frames 11-16 swing arms forward ending with both claw hands nearly extended to the RIGHT at shoulder/chest height, slight torso lean. End has near arm extended forward at chest height for contact. Feet planted, realistic shoulder sockets, head attached.

strike.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: 16 consecutive frames of the short CONTACT and FOLLOW-THROUGH of a zombie's two-handed forward clawing strike. First pose both arms extended to RIGHT at upper chest height, knees softly bent, torso slightly leaning forward. Over sixteen frames finish the claw push with tiny hand recoil, realistic elbow bend, weight settling onto front foot. Both arms must remain clearly attached to deltoids below collar, coherent whole body. Do not return hands to idle yet.

recover.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: Sixteen complete consecutive sprite frames RETURNING from a two-handed melee strike to idle, SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT. Start both arms extended to RIGHT at chest height, smoothly flex elbows and lower hands, settle weight to hunched standing idle with wrists at hips. Feet stay planted, believable shoulder sockets below neck. Must be transparent 4x4, no contact sheet background or numbers.

hurt.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: Sixteen consecutive frames of a small gunshot flinch, SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT. Hunched standing idle with hanging arms -> chest recoils backward slightly and elbows draw in -> return to idle. Feet planted. Do not show bullets, damage effects or blood, no dismemberment. Transparent 4x4 ONLY; no scenic contact sheet, grid lines or numbers.

stunned.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: Sixteen frames seamless stunned standing sway loop, fixed side profile facing RIGHT. Planted feet, torso gently swaying, hanging arms with slight tremble and attached head sagging by collar. No stars or effects. Must stay SIDE facing right, never front portrait. Transparent 4x4 ONLY with no labels or contact sheet background.

fall.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: Sixteen consecutive evenly spaced frames of a FORWARD KNOCKDOWN facing RIGHT. Frame1 upright hunch. Frames2-5 knees flex, arms reach forward; 6-10 drops onto knees and hands; 11-16 chest settles to prone on stomach, feet LEFT head RIGHT. Head always attached. Same anatomical body scale even when lying; full body inside each cell. Transparent 4x4 ONLY, no ground or labels.

get_up.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: Sixteen consecutive evenly spaced frames of getting up, SIDE facing RIGHT. Frame1 horizontal prone, feetleft/headright -> push chest up on hands -> tuck a knee under hips -> kneel -> rise to hunched standing idle at frame16. Body scale constant, do not enlarge prone frames. Transparent 4x4 ONLY; no environment, floor, grid or numbers.

prone_idle.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: 16 consecutive frames of a seamless PRONE IDLE loop. Whole zombie lying flat along floor, feet LEFT, head RIGHT, elbows bent under shoulders, head slightly raised close to collar. Slow breathing in chest and very slight weight shift, fingers resting on floor, legs fully drawn and outstretched. Character never stands. Side view only, fit entire horizontal body inside each cell. Transparent 4 by4 grid withNO lines.

crawl.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: Sixteen consecutive sprite frames of one seamless PRONE CRAWL cycle in place, SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT. Entire body horizontal feetLEFT headRIGHT, alternately plant forearms and flex elbows to pull torso, both intact legs dragging with slight knee flex. Head raised slightly at attached short neck, real shoulder sockets below collar. Never stand. Horizontal full body must fit each cell at same anatomical scale as standing. Transparent4x4 ONLY, no floor, shadows, labels or lines.

crawl_windup.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: 16 consecutive frames of a PRONE melee attack windup and swing facing RIGHT, entire body horizontal feetleft headright. Begin elbows planted and chest low; draw near hand toward chest, rear forearm supports weight; then extend near hand and claw RIGHT. Last frame near arm extended low-forward for contact, head close to collar and gaze forward. Real shoulder and elbow anatomy, body remains prone. Exactly 16 sprites in4x4 transparentgrid.

crawl_strike.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: 16 consecutive frames of PRONE claw strike CONTACT and brief follow-through to RIGHT. Body horizontal feetleft headright, chest low near floor, far elbow supports chest, near arm starts extended low-forward and pushes slightly farther, fingers hook then recoil very slightly. Head remains attached near collar, legs drag unchanged. No upright or kneeling frames. Exactly16 complete character sprites4x4 transparent.

crawl_recover.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: 16 consecutive frames recovering from PRONE forward claw strike. Body horizontal feetleft headright. Start near arm reaching right and far elbow planted; slowly flex near elbow to bring hand back under its shoulder, chest lowers, ending in prone breathing idle supported on forearms. Head close to collar, same full body. No stand up. Exactly16 sprites4x4 transparent.

crawl_hurt.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: 16 frames of a small PRONE hit reaction. Entire soldier horizontal feetleft headright lying on forearms. Chest and attached head flinch backward slightly, hands tense and recover. No limb removal, no sparks orblood visualeffects, no stand up. Transparent full-body4x4 sprites.

shove.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: 16 consecutive frames PRONE SHOVING UPWARD to dislodge someone standing on the back. Body stays horizontal feetleft headright on floor, near shoulder is part of torso. Begin braced on elbows, push one open palm upward with natural bent elbow and shoulder, then return to forearm support. No second person, no objects. Same body scale, entire body inside each cell, exactly16 in4x4.

airborne.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: 16 consecutive frames of a seamless AIRBORNE fall loop, facing RIGHT, fully intact soldier suspended without ground contact. Legs loosely bent at hips/knees, feet tucked, arms slightly forward for balance, cloth lifting subtly, head attached and gaze ahead. No flying upward or superhero pose, no scenery. Same full-body scale and foot reference as standing. 4x4 grid.

land.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: 16 consecutive frames of LANDING after a small fall facing RIGHT. Frame1 feet touch floor, knees softly flexed. Frames2-8 bend knees/hips to absorb impact, hands forward balancing, head connected. Frames9-16 rise to hunched standing idle, wrists near hips. No ground drawn.16 complete sprites4x4.

death.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: 16 consecutive frames of a DEATH collapse facing RIGHT, feetleft/headright when down. Start hunched standing, knees buckle, roll down through knee/hand support, finish lying ON SIDE along floor with head attached to collar and arms relaxed, motionless final pose. Not dismemberment, no gore or blood effects or ground. Keep fixed body scale even in horizontal poses, all body fits each cell. 4x4.

prone_death.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: 16 consecutive frames of death while already PRONE facing RIGHT, body horizontal feetleft headright. Begin propped weakly on forearms, elbows give way, chest settles, head lowers to rest on forearm at collar, finish entirely still on floor, same fully connected body. Never stand or kneel, no gore, no ground drawn, same body scale throughout.16 whole body sprites4x4.

prone_stunned.motion_prompt: Animation ONLY: 16 frames of seamless PRONE stunned loop. Entire body horizontal feetleft headright low on forearms, head attached near collar and sagging a little, arms tremble gently, shoulder chest small sway. No standing up, no stars or text or effects. Fourbyfour16fullcharacters transparent.
